question.knowledge_point: Dividing Rational Expressions with Multiple Common Factors
question.worked_solution:
To compute

$$
a÷b=\frac{3(z-2)}{(z+1)^{2}}÷\frac{z-2}{6(z+1)},
$$

we just need to multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3(z-2)}{(z+1)^{2}}÷\frac{z-2}{6(z+1)} & = \\ \frac{3(z-2)}{(z+1)^{2}}\cdot \frac{6(z+1)}{z-2} & = \\ \frac{3\cancel{(z-2)}}{(z+1)^{\cancel{2}}}\cdot \frac{6\cancel{(z+1)}}{\cancel{(z-2)}} & = \\ \frac{3}{z+1}\cdot 6 & = \\ \frac{18}{z+1}\end{aligned}
$$
